description: Approximately-maximum-likelihood phylogenies. Consumes an Alignment and produces a Tree - the third port type, and the far end of the first real pipeline.

infer.description: -nt selects nucleotide mode. Without it FastTree assumes protein and returns a wrong tree rather than an error; WITH it, a protein alignment produces a plausible tree under the wrong model, which is worse. Hence requires.alphabet - see BLU-22.
